tab.title: Tweakwise
tab.variants: This product has variants. Please check the variant to get Tweakwise data from that specific variant.
tab.noAccessToken: To get the data from Tweakwise, we need an access token. For this instance, no access token is configured. Please create an access token in Tweakwise and configure it in the Tweakwise Frontent module
tab.syncSuccessMessage: The product is synced successfully to Tweakwise. Please make sure to publish changes in Tweakwise to make them available in the frontend.
tab.syncFailedMessage: The product could not be synced to Tweakwise. Please contact support if this error keeps occurring.
tab.syncSkippedParentMessage: This product has variants and is not included in feeds with 'Export all variants' enabled. Please sync the individual variants instead.
tab.syncSkippedChildMessage: Child products are excluded from this feed.
tab.syncVariantsConfirmMessage: This product has variants and is not part of this feed. In grouped mode, only the variants are exported. Would you like to sync all variants instead?
tab.syncVariantsSuccessMessage: All variants have been synced to Tweakwise. Please make sure to publish changes in Tweakwise to make them available in the frontend.
tab.parentUsesVariantListingConfirmMessage: This product's listing shows a variant, not the parent product. Would you like to sync all variants for this feed instead?
tab.parentHasMainVariantConfirmMessage: This product's listing is configured to show a specific variant, not the parent product. Would you like to sync that variant instead?
tab.syncMainVariantSuccessMessage: The listing's main variant has been synced to Tweakwise. Please make sure to publish changes in Tweakwise to make them available in the frontend.

listing.warning: These settings will have no effect if you have enabled the option to export all variants to Tweakwise. In that case, Tweakwise will control which variants are displayed in the frontend.
